posts.text: ADHD doesn’t mean I can’t focus—it means I can’t *choose* what to focus on. Anyone else? Anyone else?
I stopped calling it procrastination. Now it’s ‘creative buffering.’
Adult ADHD means spending years thinking you're broken—then realizing you're just misunderstood.
My ADHD brain thinks the internet is an amusement park. This hit.
My ADHD brain sees deadlines as plot twists and honestly, I’m proud of the chaos.
ADHD isn’t a lack of focus. It’s too much focus... just never on the right thing at the right time. 💀
